channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Na eleição, o risco para a economia não é o ambientalismo
item.description: The 2026 election threatens the economy not through environmentalism but through regulatory instability and increasing judicialization, especially with proposals to change environmental legislation. Litigation in the economic sector has grown exponentially, creating uncertainty and impacting business planning.

item.title: MAPA: No 2º turno, Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro priorizam maiores colégios eleitorais e visitam mais de uma cidade por dia
item.description: In the runoff, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro focused their campaigns on São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro, often visiting multiple cities per day. Lula visited eight states and the Federal District, while Flávio covered nine states and the DF, targeting the Southeast region, home to 41.78% of voters.

item.title: Lula faz live com Janones e diz que “guerra vai ser ganha”
item.description: Lula held a live stream with André Janones after the Globo debate, where he declared that the 'war' against Flávio Bolsonaro will be won and thanked him for creating the 'Exército do Lula', a WhatsApp channel with 10 million followers used to mobilize supporters until the runoff.

item.title: Voto, sigilo e liberdade: do celular na cabine à prisão em período eleitoral
item.description: The incident of Romeu Zema filmed with a cell phone at the polling station revives debates on electoral rules. The arrest of voters is restricted between five days before the election and 48 hours after its closure, except in cases of flagrante delict, final conviction, or violation of safe conduct. Electoral crimes are judged by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Fator Mark Zuckerberg: o peso da Meta na eleição brasileira
item.description: Twelve Democratic members of the U.S. House of Representatives sent a letter to Mark Zuckerberg alleging that Meta intends to interfere in the 2026 Brazilian election in favor of Bolsonarismo, underscoring the role of digital platforms as political tools and concerns over foreign interference in Brazil's electoral process.

item.title: Jorginho diz que Lula está “cuspindo” e ameaça sair da 1ª fila
item.description: Santa Catarina Governor Jorginho Mello (PL) said he would leave the front row of the TV Globo presidential debate because, according to him, President Lula (PT) was 'spitting' during the confrontation with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The debate, held on Friday (October 23, 2026), was the second direct encounter between the candidates; the first was on Band. Voting in the second round takes place on Sunday (October 25), from 8am to 5pm, Brasília time.

item.title: Bota pra Virar x Bloco do 22: Brasília vai "parar" na véspera da eleição
item.description: On the eve of the runoff election, Brasília will host two opposing protests — one from the left (Bota pra Virar) and one from the right (Bloco do 22) — scheduled at the same time and roughly two kilometers apart. The entire Esplanada dos Ministérios will be closed to traffic to ensure safety and prevent clashes. Politicians from various parties have confirmed attendance at both events.

item.title: Apoios e neutralidade: os possíveis rumos dos 9 milhões de votos da 3ª via
item.description: Third-way candidates received over 9 million votes, with Caiado and Zema endorsing Flávio Bolsonaro and Cury declaring vote after demanding governance without hatred. Renan Santos remained neutral, allowing free voting. Datafolha survey indicates no automatic vote transfer to Flávio, with only 40% migrating.

item.title: Conheça os planos econômicos de Lula e Flávio para os próximos anos
item.description: Lula and Flávio present opposing economic plans for Brazil, focusing on sustainable growth, public investments and social policies. Lula maintains the fiscal framework and prioritizes infrastructure, industry and income transfer programs, while Flávio proposes ministry cuts and a more liberal economy.

item.title: Canais de WhatsApp de Lula e Flávio mostram força do digital no 2º turno
item.description: The WhatsApp channels 'Exército do Lula' and 'Tropa do Flávio', led by André Janones and Nikolas Ferreira, highlighted the strength of digital communication in the 2026 runoff. The Lula channel, with over 10 million followers, faced legal disputes at the TSE, ending with a ruling requiring Meta to provide data on its coordinated activity.

item.title: Governo Lula ou Flávio: o que ambos defendem para a relação com os EUA
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro advocate different approaches toward the US, with the former prioritizing strategic autonomy and multilateral dialogue, while the latter seeks closer alignment with Donald Trump. Both will face the challenge of negotiating 37.5% tariffs imposed by the US on Brazilian goods, which affect 23.1% of exports to the country.

item.title: Lula divide verba de campanha entre rua e redes; Flávio foca no digital
item.description: Lula spread campaign funds across digital outreach, street rallies, and printed materials, while Flávio Bolsonaro focused primarily on digital strategies and social media. This difference reflects contrasting mobilization profiles and comfort with the online environment.

item.title: Por que o interior do Estado do Rio vota diferente da capital? Entenda
item.description: The 2026 elections highlighted the voting divergence between Rio de Janeiro's capital and its inland regions, where over 53% of voters outside the capital directly influenced outcomes, particularly in state legislative elections and the PL's strength. Candidates and parties intensified campaigns in inland municipalities, underscoring the strategic importance of areas such as São Gonçalo, Niterói, and the Lakes Region.

item.title: Flávio amplia propostas a dois dias da votação e anuncia medidas fora do plano de governo no debate da TV Globo
item.description: In his final debate before the runoff, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) expanded proposals beyond his government plan, adding e-sports to Student Games, harsher penalties for animal abuse, and investments in the National Cancer Institute. He also supported the Northeast Train connecting nine capitals, technical education with companies, and the revival of Student Games.

item.title: Quaest divulga última pesquisa presidencial neste sábado (24/10)
item.description: Quaest will release its final presidential poll on Saturday (24/10), with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence. From October 17-20, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) led with 45% and Lula (PT) with 44%, a statistical tie.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro fazem últimos atos de campanha em MG, Rio e SP
item.description: Lula and Flávio wrap up presidential campaign with rallies in MG, Rio, and SP, competing for votes in Southeast where Flávio leads. São Paulo, Rio, and Minas gather around 30% of the electorate.

item.title: Eleições 2026: veja as agendas de Flávio e Lula neste sábado (24/10)
item.description: On Saturday (October 24), Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro hold their final campaign events before the runoff. Lula walks in Rio and concludes his campaign in São Paulo at 4 PM. Flávio attends Bloco do 22 rallies in Belo Horizonte and Rio.

item.title: Lula busca virada no 2º turno contra Flávio Bolsonaro e tenta reverter tendência de alternância de poder nas Américas
item.description: Lula seeks to reverse the power alternation trend in the Americas, facing Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff. In 11 of the last 17 democratic elections on the continent, there was power alternation, including opposition wins in Argentina, Chile, and Colombia. Right-wing shifts in Latin America and declining popularity of incumbent governments reinforce the change scenario.

item.title: SUS, ensino de matemática, crise climática e população em situação de rua: veja temas que ficaram à margem das campanhas
item.description: During the 2026 presidential race, issues like healthcare (especially SUS funding), education (focusing on math and high school), climate impacts (such as El Niño), and homelessness received little attention in the debate between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula. Despite their social relevance, these topics were largely sidelined in campaign proposals and public discourse. The TV Globo debate was one of the few instances where some of these issues were partially addressed.

item.title: Roblox, fandoms e bloquinho: como a geração Z entrou na disputa entre Flávio e Lula
item.description: The 2026 race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro engaged Gen Z through digital and cultural movements. Platforms like Roblox, fandoms, and funk parodies were used by supporters of both candidates to mobilize young voters aged 16 to 30, blending politics with entertainment and social media.

item.title: Presidente do TSE fará pronunciamento em rede nacional na véspera do 2º turno e orientará eleitor a conferir local de votação
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques will deliver a nationwide broadcast urging voters to check their polling locations ahead of the second round. He will note that 100 polling places and 361 voting sections have changed and emphasize that missing the first round does not affect eligibility in the second. Voters can confirm their location via the e-Título app or the Electronic Self-Service portal on TSE and TRE websites.

item.title: Vovó e vovô querem votar: idosos com mais de 70 contam o que os levarão às urnas no segundo turno
item.description: Over eight million seniors aged 70 or older voted in the first round of 2026, with abstention dropping from 58.86% to 49.19%. Key motivations include defending democracy, caring for children and grandchildren, and hoping for improvements in health and education. The 70+ vote is encouraged as a civic act and form of resistance, supported by digital tools that simplify voter registration and election information.

item.title: Os cálculos da cúpula militar sobre a chance de Flávio fazer uma “caça às bruxas” nas Forças
item.description: After Flávio Bolsonaro overtakes Lula in the second round, the military leadership sees him as the favorite to assume the Planalto Palace, but has not yet shown concern about a possible 'witch hunt' against officers who opposed the coup and hold high command positions in the Lula government.

item.title: Derrotado no 1º turno, STF faz recuo tático na reta final da campanha
item.description: After playing a prominent role in the first round with controversial decisions, the STF adopted a more low-profile stance in the final stretch of the 2026 elections' second round, reducing its impact on the electoral scenario. This strategy aims to avoid further polarization and ensure institutional stability.

item.title: As últimas pesquisas para presidente após o debate da Globo entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula
item.description: Datafolha and Quaest polls released after the Globo debate show a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (47%) and Lula (46%), both at 50% in valid votes. The polls, with a two-point margin of error, were conducted Friday through Saturday, partially capturing the impact of the debate and recent campaign events.

item.title: Incerteza sobre propostas de candidatos freia euforia do mercado
item.description: After a strong positive reaction on the first day following the first round, the Brazilian financial market accumulated modest fluctuations through Friday, with the Ibovespa down 0,88% since the election and the dollar nearly stable. Uncertainty about candidates' proposals and lack of details on reforms have caused investor caution, awaiting the second round result to allocate resources. Rising oil prices and international uncertainties also influenced markets, with the Fed set to decide U.S. interest rates next week.

item.title: Datafolha divulga última pesquisa presidencial neste sábado (24/10)
item.description: Datafolha will release its final poll before the presidential runoff on Saturday (October 24th) at 7 PM, with a 2-point margin of error. The latest poll, from October 22nd, shows Flávio Bolsonaro at 47% versus Lula at 46%. The firm surveyed 4,050 Brazilians in the most recent poll.

item.title: Lula sai na frente na disputa pelos indecisos, apoiado em deslizes de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A qualitative survey by Instituto Travessia showed Lula gained an edge over Flávio Bolsonaro among undecided voters, driven by backlash against Flávio's remarks on the shooting death of Ana Clara. Five of six undecided participants leaned toward Lula post-debate, citing negative reactions to Flávio's stance. Core voters of both candidates remained unchanged.

item.title: 'Comida tá cara', 'prometeu picanha', 'dúzia virou dez': Flávio usa preço de alimentos contra Lula no debate da Globo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used rising food prices to criticize Lula during the Globo debate, accusing him of being disconnected from citizens' reality. He highlighted the reduction in product packaging sizes and unfulfilled campaign promises, reinforcing the economy as a central campaign theme. The debate occurred before the runoff between the candidates.

item.title: Risadas bolsonaristas, provocação sobre chocolate e dicas de Tarcísio a Flávio: o debate da TV Globo que você não viu
item.description: The TV Globo debate was marked by tensions and provocations between Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, particularly regarding the Ana Clara Machado case. Lula referenced the presence of the girl's mother, and Flávio, who is legally defending an off-duty police officer, mistakenly called her by her daughter's name. The confrontational tone and absences such as Pablo Marçal shaped public perception, drawing criticism toward Flávio's aggressive style among undecided voters.

item.title: 'Ana Clara, quero falar para a senhora' x 'acabar com as polícias': redes exploram gafes de Flávio e Lula em debate
item.description: During a live TV Globo debate, Flávio Bolsonaro mistakenly called Ana Clara’s mother by her deceased daughter’s name, while Lula faced backlash for saying he would 'end the police' while discussing public security.

item.title: Amigo de Flávio Bolsonaro tentou usar decreto de Cláudio Castro para ampliar mansão em ilha disputada com Richarlison
item.description: Lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, attempted to use a decree by Cláudio Castro to expand a mansion on Ilha Comprida, disputed with Richarlison. The measure was revoked by interim governor Ricardo Couto amid controversies, and Tomaz faces an investigation at the STF with assets frozen.

item.title: Milei só deve reconhecer resultado das eleições no caso de vitória de Flávio, avalia Planalto
item.description: The Brazilian government does not expect recognition from Javier Milei if Lula is reelected, anticipating support only for Flávio Bolsonaro. Bilateral relations between Brazil and Argentina are tense due to Milei's statements questioning Brazilian institutions and accusing Lula of attempting electoral fraud.

item.title: 'Bolsa-farelo' e voto contra a Constituição, debate provoca alta em buscas no Google
item.description: The debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro on TV Globo led to a surge in Google searches, with users investigating past statements and episodes. Topics like 'Bolsa-farelo' and voting against the Constitution were discussed.

item.title: Em consideração final, Flávio aborda poder de compra, segurança e pede oração do Pai Nosso
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro questioned whether voters' lives have improved over the past four years and requested an Our Father prayer in his closing remarks. He addressed purchasing power and security as main themes.

item.title: Lula: Quem é amigo do Vorcaro é o Flávio, quem é filhote do Vorcaro é Flávio
item.description: In a TV Globo debate, Lula accused Daniel Vorcaro of corrupting the Republic and linked Flávio Bolsonaro to the scheme. Lula called Flávio 'Vorcaro's pup', suggesting involvement in corruption.

item.title: Lula diz que Willer Tomaz é 'sócio' de Flávio; senador diz que advogado é apenas um amigo
item.description: Lula accuses Flávio of having Willer Tomaz as a partner, while the senator denies it, calling him merely a friend. The debate centers around investigations into billionaire frauds at INSS.

item.title: Lula (PT): 'No governo do pai dele [Jair Bolsonaro, dizia que] quem tomava vacina ia virar gay. E ia virar jacaré'
item.description: Lula criticized Jair Bolsonaro for claiming, while in office, that vaccines could turn people gay or into caimans. Experts dismissed the statement as dangerous misinformation undermining vaccination efforts.

item.title: Flávio ou Lula, quem está na frente nas pesquisas? Veja números do 2º turno
item.description: Recent polls from October 21 to 23 show a tight race between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a simulated runoff, with margins of error ranging from 1.6 to 2.4 percentage points. Both candidates display similar vote intentions, reflecting a highly competitive electoral scenario.

item.title: Bets, maioridade penal, SUS, dívidas: o que Flávio e Lula falaram no debate
item.description: Lula and Flávio exchanged accusations and presented proposals on economy, security, health, and social policies in the final debate before the runoff. The debate was marked by mutual criticisms and divergences on issues such as maximum penalty, SUS, and public debt.

item.title: TSE rejeita pedido de Lula para proibir plataformas de recomendar perfis de Nikolas e Marçal
item.description: The TSE rejected Lula's request to prohibit Meta from recommending profiles of Nikolas Ferreira and Pablo Marçal. Corregidor Ricardo Villas Bôas Cuêva considered the measure could constitute undue censorship to freedom of expression. The decision was made during a virtual session on Tuesday.

item.title: Flávio recomenda Pai Nosso no debate; encerramento foi sugestão de Nikolas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) concluded his participation in the Globra debate by inviting voters to pray the Lord's Prayer, a suggestion made by federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) on social media. The gesture sparked mixed reactions among viewers and introduced a more personal and religious tone to the discussion.

item.title: Lula chama Jair de “pai do Tigrinho” e Flávio de “irmão do Tigrinho”
item.description: During a TV Globo debate in October 2026, Lula referred to Jair and Flávio Bolsonaro as 'father and brother of Tigrinho', criticizing the regulation of online betting. He highlighted the shutdown of Tigrinho platforms, banned by a provisional decree signed days earlier, and reinforced the prohibition of betting sites in Brazil. The measure, effective before the first-round vote, now awaits congressional approval.

item.title: Lula e Flávio melhoraram na Globo, mas petista venceu no saldo de pontos
item.description: Both Lula and Flávio improved in the Globo debate compared to the Band confrontation, but the PT candidate leads in net points. Lula emphasized past actions and forced Flávio to support proposals such as the real minimum wage increase and free fares, though he was criticized for focusing too much on the past. Flávio presented new promises, including zero tolls for motorcyclists, but had to respond to criticisms about controversial pandemic-era episodes.

item.title: TSE proíbe Nikolas e Marçal de publicarem conteúdo falso até a eleição sob pena de R$ 100 mil de multa
item.description: The TSE's general counsel, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, banned federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) and influencer Pablo Marçal from publishing false content until the end of the second-round election, with a fine of R$100,000 per post. The decision aims to protect the integrity of the electoral process and combat misinformation.

item.title: 'Nove dedos', 'miliciano, 'dá um Google': veja frases do debate entre Lula e Flávio na Globo
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro debated on TV Globo in the final round before the 2026 runoff election, discussing economy, security, health, and other key issues. The debate featured direct language and controversial exchanges with mutual criticism.

item.title: Lula diz que governo Bolsonaro “não acreditava na educação”
item.description: In the TV Globo debate, Lula criticized the Bolsonaro government for neglecting education and emphasized Camilo Santana's role in rebuilding school policies. He also attacked the model of civic-military schools, advocating for greater investment in public education.

item.title: 🔴 AO VIVO: LULA X FLÁVIO BOLSONARO NA GLOBO! ELEIÇÕES 2026
item.description: The video shows a live broadcast on Globo with Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro in an electoral debate for 2026. The content includes YouTube streaming technical elements and interface. No clear mention of specific political topics in the excerpt shown.

item.title: Mais Tarcísio e menos Marçal: Flávio foi melhor no debate, mas cometeu grosseria grave contra Lula
item.description: In a Globo debate, Flávio Bolsonaro outperformed Lula with a more statesman-like stance but committed a gaffe by referencing 'nine fingers' of the oil worker. Nevertheless, Lula countered by emphasizing his trajectory. Flávio’s performance may not be enough to halt Lula’s rising poll numbers.

item.title: "Parece que Flávio foi doutrinado e educado para mentir", acusa Lula
item.description: In a TV Globo debate, Lula accused Flávio Bolsonaro of repeatedly lying and being 'trained to lie', especially regarding the Master Bank and Richarlison island case. Flávio fired back saying Lula 'promises nothing' and compared his pledges to 'steak and pumpkin'. The candidates exchanged accusations over secrecy documents and corporate spending.
